Cash Flow Statement — Edit

The Cash Flow Statement form is used to configure report parameters.

Set the reporting period and method to analyze cash movements.

Description

Enter an optional description for this report configuration.

Method

Select the method for preparing the cash flow statement: Direct or Indirect method.

Periods

Define the time periods to display. You can add multiple periods for comparison.

Footer

Enter text to display at the bottom of the report.

Exclude zero balances

Check this box to hide items with zero balances from the report.

Round decimals

Check this box to round amounts to whole numbers on the report.
